svg.desc: 982 commits across five public projects, 68 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-08-30 through 2026-11-21 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-21T21:37:37.705Z.
